title: Tomb of Thutmose II announced over a year after discovery

tellings.quote: When I was there in October, I heard about that tomb uh having been discovered earlier in 2024.

plain: The tomb of Thutmose II, an ancient Egyptian pharaoh, is said to have been found early in 2024 but announced to the public more than a year later. Luke Caverns, a researcher who explores ancient Egyptian sites, says he heard about the find while he was in Egypt in October 2024. He tells it to suggest that big discoveries in Egypt can be held back for a long time before the public hears of them.
